gap_text: No generalized multi-provider comparator exists. compare.py is hard-coded to AAPL, 25 sessions and the Alpaca collector, so a Databento or Massive arm cannot be scored without new code.
next_check: Parameterize compare.py by provider, symbol list and session range. Verify it reproduces the existing AAPL 25-session Alpaca result and scores a second symbol.

preregistration.expectation: A new parameterized comparator (provider, symbols, session range) reproduces the original compare.py AAPL 25-session output field-for-field (bars 25/25 equal, max diff 0.00; actions numeric 2, unknown_currency 1) and scores a second symbol from the retained broad-market Alpaca raw daily parquet against LEAN's bundled raw daily data.
preregistration.criteria: settled if (a) the AAPL result JSON equals original compare.py output except the comparison_code hash, (b) a second symbol is scored with nonzero compared sessions, and (c) a provider-neutral normalized-file arm exists so a Databento/Massive export needs no new code; negative control: perturbing one close must flip status to differences (detection).

fix_round_preregistration.expectation: After fixing reference-status handling, per-symbol action filtering and empty-reference handling, the AAPL result stays identical to compare.py and the second-symbol counts are unchanged.
fix_round_preregistration.criteria: identical=true again; new controls: unavailable reference -> bars unavailable (not equal); symbol absent from reference -> unavailable/no_reference_sessions; other-symbol action rows excluded from provider_records.

detection_method: Negative control: a single +0.01 close perturbation in the normalized-csv arm flips status to differences (different=1); the session-count guard rejects a wrong expectation.
limits: The parameterized comparator is a successor module under blueprints/gap-wave2-20260923/ (reusing compare.py's numeric validation); blueprints/us-equities/authenticated-data/compare.py itself was not edited because its hash is pinned in earlier receipts and it is outside this unit's owned paths. Promotion into the authenticated-data blueprint is left to the coordinator, so the gap text 'compare.py is hard-coded' still literally holds.

No Databento or Massive data exists on this host and acquiring it needs paid/credentialed access; a Databento/Massive arm needs only a normalized CSV export (symbol,session_date,close) but that arm was exercised with a LEAN-derived CSV, not a real Databento/Massive export.

Second-symbol disagreements (notably SPY on ~91% of sessions) are unexplained here: LEAN's bundled daily close and Alpaca's SIP daily close likely use different close definitions for ETFs; the comparator reports, it does not diagnose. The parquet arm converts stored doubles with repr() (shortest round-trip text).
Private Alpaca data was read in memory only; only aggregate counts are published.
